context_diary: When searching for a random currency agent, the system returns a limited number of results to avoid overloading. In this case, one out of four matched agents was returned, and their phone number was verified. This suggests that the system enforces a limit on query results and that phone verification is a field that can be directly retrieved. In the future, if a more specific search is needed, the user should provide additional criteria to narrow the results.
